subject.title: fix #95895: [Security]: GEMINI_API_KEY written as a plaintext literal in the generated systemd service unit

question: Should OpenClaw accept this narrowed policy that makes Google/Gemini auth-profile env refs file-backed in generated systemd service environments while leaving other auth-profile env refs unchanged?
rationale: The code path and proof are strong, but CI cannot decide whether this provider-specific credential-delivery boundary is the intended security and compatibility policy for installed services.

options.title: Accept Narrow File-Backed Policy
options.body: Merge this PR after final maintainer review if Google/Gemini auth-profile keys should use the existing generated EnvironmentFile contract.

options.title: Request Generic Auth-Profile Policy
options.body: Ask for a revision if all eligible auth-profile env refs should share one generic file-backed policy rather than a Google/Gemini allowlist.

options.title: Defer Auth-Profile Scope
options.body: Keep or close this PR outside the current fix if maintainers want the linked security issue limited to config SecretRefs for now.

recommendation.title: Accept Narrow File-Backed Policy
recommendation.body: Merge this PR after final maintainer review if Google/Gemini auth-profile keys should use the existing generated EnvironmentFile contract.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged the current-main config SecretRef repair for the same issue and have the clearest maintainer-side context for the remaining auth-profile boundary.
